text:
sarah_pm: Quick ask — we need a one-pager (exec-friendly) that summarizes security, SLAs, and deploy-mode guidance for enterprise buyers. Output: field-ready PDF, a short landing post, and slide 1 for the webinar. Deadline: first draft by EOD Thu. Primary audiences: CISO, platform engineering, procurement. Who can take lead?

mike_marketing: I can draft the messaging and hero stat. I’ll pull SLA bullets from product. Need a concise benchmark stat to drive the banner. @devon_rd do we have a single-line bench we can use?

devon_rd: Yes — internal perf run vs baseline GPT-style endpoint: ~2.3x lower p50 latency on identical GPU config when using batching + KV caching. Suggested copy: '~2.3x lower median inference latency vs baseline with smart batching & KV cache.' I’ll attach the detailed run results.

ana_note: (typo) — ignore

ana_note2: (debug)

ana_prod: Heads up: include private deployment note — "VPC / on-prem options with KMS/HSM and audit logs". Also call out rollback SLA for canary rollouts and a short line about Dedicated capacity guarantees (we'll insert exact req/sec numbers).

greg_sales: For inbound routing from the landing page: use tags `enterprise-security` and `enterprise-dedicated`. Routing: `enterprise-security` -> AE queue A (east), `enterprise-dedicated` -> Solutions Eng queue. Add `webinar_interest` checkbox to route high-intent leads to SDR follow-up.

lisa_design: I’ll do a tight visual one-pager. Suggested sections: top banner stat, three-column feature row (Security | SLAs | Deployment Modes), 2-line customer proof, CTAs: `Request pilot` and `Join webinar`. Which CTA text do we want?

mike_marketing: CTA options: `Request pilot` + `Join webinar`. Optionally shorter: `Get pilot` / `Join webinar`. Leaning on `Request pilot` as primary.

devon_rd: Benchmark narrative — I’ll produce a 1-line blurb + link to full doc: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/enterprise-latency-2026. For the one-pager use the blurb and footnote link.

sarah_pm: Please also add a one-sentence failure-mode note: 'automatic fallback to compatible model variant and multi-region routing to uphold SLOs during capacity or infra events.'

mike_marketing: Webinar plan: 30 min presentation + 15 min live Q&A. Slide owners: intro (Mike), technical deep-dive and benchmark (Devon), deployment patterns & security (Ana), customer Q&A (Greg). Proposed date: Apr 14. Landing page + registration should tag inbound with `webinar_apr14_enterprise`.

greg_sales: :thumbsup: I’ll prepare two anonymized customer anecdotes (compliant fintech + health provider) to include as proof points.

lisa_design: Uploading hero mock in Figma now — will drop link here. Will follow the 1px rule for the SLA visual weight.

ops_bot: Reminder — marketing assets must pass compliance review before publish. Current review ETA: 48 hours.

sarah_pm: Final asks and owners: Mike -> first draft by Thu 5pm PT; Devon + Ana -> confirm numeric SLA / benchmark values by Thu noon; Lisa -> PDF layout Fri AM; Greg -> routing rules in Salesforce by Fri EOD. I’ll coordinate legal/compliance review after the draft. Thanks everyone! :eyes:
